title: Meeting a Friend
description: Put it all together — a natural conversation catching up with a friend in Hindi.

pairs.right: how are you / how's it going

exercises.explanation: A full casual encounter — these four phrases form the skeleton of meeting a friend in Hindi.
'Kya haal hai?' = how's it going? / how are you? A casual alternative to 'tum kaise ho'.

exercises.question: You run into a friend you haven't seen in months. What do you say?
exercises.explanation: 'Bahut din baad mila!' = long time no see! (literally: met after many days). A very natural expression.

exercises.sentence: Aaj kal kya ___? (What are you up to these days?)
exercises.explanation: 'Aaj kal kya kar rahe ho?' = what are you up to these days? A natural way to catch up.
'Kahan the?' = where were you? / where have you been? Very casual. 'Kahan gaye the?' = where did you go?

exercises.question: How do you say 'let's meet again' in Hindi?
exercises.explanation: 'Phir milenge' = we'll meet again — the most natural colloquial goodbye in Hindi.
'Bahut din baad mila!' = long time no see! Bahut = very/many, din = days, baad = after, mila = met.
'Apna khayal rakhna' = take care of yourself. A warm way to part from a friend.
